note: mismatch_cases lists the eight generated baseline mismatch inputs: generated_geometry is the original seed/index world and the diff statistics are for that generated input. The clusters array uses the retained reduced corpus case; shrinking may change parameters as well as pixels, so a cluster representative can have a different mismatch magnitude than the generated case at the same seed/index. The full 300-case scratch report is orchestra/state/T08-triage-smoother2/triage.json (not committed).
